patches.notes: Adds ProviderTextGeneration support via Copilot ACP for automatic thread titles and commit messages.

patches.title: fix(server): Copilot threads can call optional T3 tools again
patches.notes: Replaces tool_search dynamic MCP capability swap with stable t3_help/t3_call gateway; adapted t3ToolSummary.ts to gt-i18n and added upstream issues/pull_requests/t3_submit_output tools to McpToolGroups.ts.

patches.title: fix(acp-registry): match registry-id basenames for copilot, kimi, and claude

patches.title: fix(acp): list Copilot skills in the skill menu
patches.notes: Discovers personal/plugin/project Copilot skills and rewrites $skill mentions to /skill; preserved direct child skill folders named build/dist/vendor/coverage inside skills containers.

patches.title: fix(provider-acp): retire Copilot tasks when their runtime ends
patches.notes: Scopes Copilot subagent attribution per runtime WeakMap and terminalizes runtime-owned subagents when the Copilot process exits; preserved Copilot 1.0.114+ agentId delta and toolIdentityByCallId routing.

patches.title: fix(acp): retain delivered instructions when reopening a conversation
patches.notes: Persists SHA-256 instruction delivery digest in providerThread.nativeMetadata.acpInstructions across session reopen/restart and invalidates on compaction or rollback.

patches.title: fix(server): slash commands reach the provider verbatim when context is pending
patches.notes: Repurposed and merged upstream in ecdd8e2c21 (2026-11-22) as generic pending-context slash command fix.

patches.title: fix(acp): dev servers an ACP agent starts show under its thread

patches.title: fix(effect-acp): a failed write no longer hides the agent's exit
patches.notes: Gives broken stdin writes and UnexpectedEof reads a 250ms grace check for child exit so AcpProcessExitedError is reported instead of AcpTransportError.

patches.title: fix(acp): only send stdio MCP servers to agents that advertise stdio
